_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: trial log ORs ~ N(-0.4, 0.2^2)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same mean, HK interval, tau^2, I^2, Q, prediction interval and DL comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 7e-7 (I^2 on the percentage scale). Local R had metafor 5.2.1; CI installs 5.0-1. harness/synthesis_examples.test.py checks tau^2 maximizes the restricted log-likelihood and the HK SE formula, and measures coverage over the seeds (HK 0.92, DL-z 0.91 over 100).

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the mean (-0.4) from zero. Measured by harness/synthesis_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic (owner decisions E5, E6).
